products.editorialSummary: An engineer’s notebook is not the obvious place to begin a story about watch dial, which is precisely why it works. The watch waiting behind the lines is Omega Specialities CK 859. The sector-style minute track, small seconds, syringe-shaped hands, and spare Arabic numerals give the CK 859 its unusually literate, almost scientific character. If Omega proved anything, it was that observatory precision met the romance of exploration. The watch dial gives that belief a distinctly restless accent. The result feels less invented than discovered, as though it had been waiting inside the idea all along. Somewhere in its restless reserve, the engineer’s notebook remains.
